turns.content: I've been at my current job for four years and I'm starting to feel ready for a new challenge.
Four years is a good run — long enough to have built something, enough time to feel the itch. What's drawing you toward a change?
I've learned everything I can here. The projects have become repetitive and I'm not growing anymore.
Stagnation is a real career risk. Are you thinking about moving within the same industry or something different?
Probably the same field but a larger company where I can specialise more. My current role is very generalist.
Specialisation makes sense at this stage. Have you started updating your portfolio?
I've been doing that. Also trying to be more active on LinkedIn which does not come naturally to me.
It doesn't for most people. Consistent engagement beats sporadic posts — even just commenting thoughtfully on others' work helps.
